name: Removal Tactical (Disrupt Vertical)
description: P1 has a vertical 3-in-a-row at col 1 (rows 3-5), threatening row 2 for a win. P0 has one removal. P0 can either: (a) play col 1 to block by placement, or (b) remove P1's piece at row 3 col 1, breaking the vertical stack entirely. Tests whether removal is used as a strategic disruption tool.
